scripts.dev: bun scripts/kill-dev-ports.ts && concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "bun run dev:web" "bun run dev:api"
scripts.dev:web: bun scripts/kill-dev-ports.ts --web && bun scripts/run-workspace.ts web dev
scripts.dev:api: bun scripts/kill-dev-ports.ts --api && bun scripts/run-workspace.ts api dev
scripts.check-types: bun --cwd packages/core check-types && bun --cwd packages/api check-types && bun --cwd packages/web check-types
